titleJa: にぎわうレストランの店内
description: 明るく現代的なレストランの店内を描いた場面である。手前には2人の若者が4人掛けのテーブルに座って食事をしている。左側の男性はスプーンを持ちながら皿の料理を食べようとしており、右側の女性はテーブルの向こう側に座り、飲み物の近くに手を置いている。テーブルにはご飯料理、飲み物、カップ、小皿、カトラリー、ナプキン、スマートフォン、緑色のメニューブックなどが並んでいる。左奥にはオープンキッチンがあり、カウンターの上には棚や小さな植物、食材容器などが見える。後ろの壁には4枚の大きな料理写真が縦長のフレームに入って並んでいる。店内には緑色のベンチシート、木と籐を組み合わせた椅子、白い柱、天井照明があり、温かみのある現代的な内装になっている。児童生徒が、前景・背景・左右・テーブルの上・壁の上などの位置関係を英語で描写する練習に適した場面である。
imagePrompt: A high-quality detailed educational illustration for an English picture-description speaking test. Base the restaurant layout, furniture arrangement, lighting, and spatial composition closely on the provided reference photograph, but remove and replace every real restaurant name, logo, menu name, product label, commercial slogan, and identifying text with original fictional designs, simple icons, or nonessential decorative lettering. Do not use proper nouns. Show a bright, modern casual restaurant interior viewed from approximately seated eye level. Exactly two visible people must appear in the entire image, no more and no less. In the foreground center, show a rectangular white tabletop with a dark wooden edge and four chairs around it. Two young adults should be seated across or diagonally from each other. On the left foreground, show a young man wearing a simple red-and-navy short-sleeved shirt. He is holding a spoon naturally and is about to eat a rice-based meal from a white plate. He should look relaxed and cheerful. On the right side of the same table, show a young woman wearing a light blue loose shirt and a dark casual hat. She is seated upright and resting one hand near a drink while looking toward her companion with a calm friendly expression. Do not show a third diner. On the tabletop, clearly include one plate of rice with a cooked main dish, another white plate containing a different meal, one glass of iced coffee with a black straw, one tall clear citrus drink with ice and a straw, one white coffee cup and saucer, two small side dishes, spoons and forks, folded napkins, one dark smartphone lying flat near the right side, and one closed dark green menu folder near the center-right. Keep all table objects realistically arranged and easy to identify. Behind the diners, include a green upholstered bench seat separated from the background by a low wooden divider with vertical slats and translucent panels. On the left background, show an open kitchen and service counter. Include a light-colored counter front, dark countertop, shelves with small green potted plants, unbranded food containers, spice jars, cups, and kitchen equipment. No cooks, waiters, or customers may be visible anywhere. Above the kitchen shelving, show several small decorative digital panels containing original abstract food icons and fictional lettering only. In the center, include a wide white vertical structural column with narrow grooves. Across the back wall, show exactly four large framed food photographs or food illustrations in tall rounded rectangular frames. The four displays should depict clearly different dishes: a bowl of noodles, a rice-and-meat dish, a curry-like dish, and a colorful pasta or seafood dish. Each panel may contain a small original symbol but no real language or recognizable commercial name. Between the food panels, include warm round wall lights and decorative vertical wall molding. Use warm ceiling spotlights and thin linear ceiling lights to create a bright contemporary restaurant atmosphere. On the right background, show empty dark wooden chairs with woven cane backs and additional empty tables, but absolutely no additional people. Preserve the realistic layout of the reference photograph: open kitchen on the left, large central column, food panels along the rear wall, dining table with two people in the foreground, green bench seating behind them, and rows of chairs to the right. Exactly two visible human figures, no staff, no customers in the background, no reflections of people, and no human images on posters. No animals, no speech bubbles, no copyrighted characters, no recognizable logos, and no proper nouns. Landscape 16:9 composition, polished educational illustration rather than photography, realistic human proportions, realistic restaurant furniture and architecture, information-rich but visually organized and suitable for describing indoor space, meals, furniture, positions, foreground and background.

sentences.text: The image presents a contemporary restaurant interior in which the foreground dining table serves as the main visual focus.
sentences.ja: この画像は、前景の食卓が主な視覚的焦点となっている現代的なレストラン店内を描いています。

sentences.text: The two diners occupy the foreground, while the open kitchen, structural column, and framed food displays establish several layers of depth behind them.
sentences.ja: 2人の食事客が前景を占め、その後ろにオープンキッチン、構造柱、額入りの料理写真が配置され、複数の奥行きが生まれています。

sentences.text: A variety of dishes, drinks, tableware, and personal items are arranged across the tabletop without making it appear excessively cluttered.
sentences.ja: さまざまな料理、飲み物、食器、私物が、過度に雑然と見えないようテーブル上に配置されています。

sentences.text: The open kitchen along the left side provides a clear contrast with the more relaxed dining area in the foreground.
sentences.ja: 左側のオープンキッチンは、前景のより落ち着いた飲食スペースとはっきり対照をなしています。

sentences.text: The grooved central column visually divides the service area from the row of food displays on the rear wall.
sentences.ja: 溝のある中央の柱が、サービスエリアと奥の壁に並ぶ料理展示を視覚的に分けています。

sentences.text: The four large framed dishes function as prominent decorative elements and make the restaurant's food-focused identity immediately clear.
sentences.ja: 4枚の大きな料理展示が目立つ装飾として機能し、この場所が飲食店であることをすぐに分かるようにしています。

sentences.text: Green upholstered seating, woven chair backs, wood trim, and warm lighting combine to create an inviting atmosphere.
sentences.ja: 緑色の布張り座席、編み込みの椅子の背、木製の縁取り、温かみのある照明が組み合わさり、居心地のよい雰囲気を生み出しています。

sentences.text: The absence of additional diners keeps the visual structure simple enough for students to focus on furniture, objects, and positional language.
sentences.ja: 他の食事客がいないことで、生徒が家具、物、位置表現に集中できる程度に視覚構造が簡潔に保たれています。

sentences.text: Overall, the scene is particularly useful for practicing how to describe foreground and background, objects on a table, features along a wall, and the spatial relationship between dining and service areas.
sentences.ja: 全体として、この場面は前景と背景、テーブル上の物、壁沿いの特徴、飲食スペースとサービスエリアの位置関係を描写する練習に特に適しています。
